notes.title: Patch Notes v1.07 - Minor Bug Fixes
Patch Notes v1.06 - Various Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Minor bug fixes
    [*]Typo fixes
    [*]Slight adjustment to timing of end screen music for several endings
    [*]Alternate solution accepted for a puzzle related to ending #12
[/list] 

Thank you to the amazingly helpful community for always pointing out bugs, typos and improvements that could be made to enhance the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.05 - Added Content: ENDING #15
notes.content:
Added an extra ending to tie up a loose story thread. Fixed some other minor bugs. 

Hope you enjoy. Good luck!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.04 - Puzzle updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added minor hints for puzzles relating to endings 5, 9 and 11 in world.
[*]Made Ending 8 puzzle more intuitive by moving parts of the puzzles to different locations.
[*]Re-worked ending 12 puzzle to only rely on information in the game.
[*]Removed tedious exploration related to ending 12 puzzle.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.02 - Minor typo fixes

notes.title: Update - Permanent 20% Price Drop
notes.content: We have decided to drop the price of Future Proof permanently from $6.99 to $4.99. Big thank you to all those people who bought it at the original full price.
